messages.content: Propose an ordered list of hypotheses from the registered IDs only. Choose model structures only; do not estimate numeric parameters. Return an object matching this JSON schema exactly: {"items":[{"hypothesis_id":"SENSOR_BIAS","rationale":"…","evidence_refs":["obs:0:1.200"]}]}. Each item requires hypothesis_id, rationale, and evidence_refs; no additional properties are allowed. Allowed IDs: SENSOR_BIAS, VELOCITY_OFFSET, SPEED_STEP, ACTUATOR_DELAY, AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET), AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP), AND(SENSOR_BIAS,ACTUATOR_DELAY), AND(VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP), AND(VELOCITY_OFFSET,ACTUATOR_DELAY), AND(SPEED_STEP,ACTUATOR_DELAY), AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP), AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,ACTUATOR_DELAY), AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP,ACTUATOR_DELAY), AND(VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP,ACTUATOR_DELAY), SENSOR_STUCK, SENSOR_SPIKE_OR_UNRELIABLE, OBJECT_MISSING_OR_DROPPED, BELT_STOP_OR_MOTION_LOSS, POST_VERIFICATION_CHANGE, UNKNOWN_OR_INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE

message.content: {"items": [{"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "Lowest RMSE among single-effect models; observed x positions are consistently offset from nominal while y remains stable, indicating a constant sensor bias combined with a speed step change.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "Lowest overall RMSE in the passing set; combining sensor bias, velocity offset, and speed step best explains the systematic deviation between nominal and observed positions.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "Matches the RMSE of AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP); adding actuator delay does not degrade fit and may capture additional timing effects.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SENSOR_BIAS", "rationale": "Consistent x-offset across all observations with stable y suggests a constant sensor bias; RMSE is low and within tolerance.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET)", "rationale": "Combines sensor bias with a constant velocity offset; RMSE is comparable to SENSOR_BIAS alone and indicates a plausible compound effect.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "Same RMSE as SENSOR_BIAS; actuator delay may be present but is not distinguishable from bias alone in this window.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,ACTUATOR_DELAY)", "rationale": "Same RMSE as AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET); adding actuator delay does not improve fit but remains a viable compound structure.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}]}
